[[File:First_raid_on_the_Sith_Citadel.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Naga Sadow frees the Daragons]]

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] launched a '''raid''' on the [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], in an attempt to free prisoners [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]]. Disguising the assault to appear as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] operation, Sadow freed the Daragons, killing venerable Sith Lord [[Simus]] in the process.
